lines: Earth's magnetic field is already weakening.
Its main dipole has faded about 6.3% per century.
Fields have flipped 183 times in 83 million years.
The last flip was 780,000 years ago.
Now switch it off completely, for just one day.
Satellites and power grids would take more charged particles.
But the air wouldn't vanish in a day; that takes far longer.
So we'd survive, but our technology would feel it first.
